summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" format entry and Control.title(title), which returns a Control with one (SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title) code. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor; it buffers the control only when is_terminal is true. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title with the code's second item. CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: a forced-terminal console test (skipped on Windows), a Control.title test, and a Windows-only renderer test asserting set_title("Hello, world!"). Not run: per instructions, no tests, scripts, or Black formatting were executed; lines were kept under 88 columns by hand. Nothing committed.
